title: fix(plugin-webhooks): gate webhook redelivery on webhook-administration access
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Hardening dispatched directly by QA (domain:devx); no tracking issue.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under skills/** teaches the redeliver door (git grep -i redeliver -- skills: 0 hits at b4a2146cb6); the page that does, content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx section 8, is updated in this diff

Review owed before the queue: this narrows who may call a public door (`POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver`). The contract-tier review of 957b96882b (FAIL, one must-fix and four should-fixes) is answered at b4a2146cb6; a delta review by that seat is owed on this head.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Webhook 重投递入口(`POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver`,两个入口面)在登录校验之后、读取请求体之前,由安全服务判定调用者是否有 Webhook 管理权限(`sys_webhook` 的对象级编辑准入);判定所用的调用者上下文按部署的租户隔离姿态解析,与数据 API 一致:隔离姿态下,会话声称的组织若已无有效成员关系,该声明不被采纳,入口以同一个 403 拒绝;重投递只写入调用者被准入的那个组织。
- 为什么改:原先"任何已登录用户都可重投递"只是早期延后实现;本轮复核指出闸门未带租户姿态,在隔离姿态下与数据 API 的准入不一致(成员关系已结束的会话仍按旧组织解析),现已对齐 2026-09-05 裁决(选项 B)的逐请求成员关系校验。
- 风险与回滚:依赖非管理员点重投递的部署改为 403(迁移:用权限集授予 `sys_webhook` 编辑权);隔离姿态下组织声明失效的会话改为 403(切换到自己所属的组织即可);未注册安全服务的部署改为 503,并在启动时打印一次提示。回滚即 revert 本 PR。待维护者定夺(人工底线,未在本 PR 内决定):重投递权限轴,按现实现为 `sys_webhook` 的 `update`,备选为投递对象上的专用能力(需改 spec)。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-entitlement.ts`(租户解析器两条腿、被丢弃组织声明的拒绝、失败方向)、`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts` 中 `serveRedeliver` 闸门段与重投递所用租户、`webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts` 新增的隔离姿态用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts`,预期 21 个用例全绿(含 isolated/group 下组织声明失效 403 且未重投、成员关系有效时放行且限定本组织、真实 ObjectKernel 上租户服务失败 503)。
- 需要你做的:裁定重投递的权限轴(保持 `sys_webhook` 的 `update`,或改为投递对象上的专用能力)。

## What changes

- **The gate.** `serveRedeliver` (the one body both faces run: the self-hosted raw-app mount and the `webhooks` slot's `handleRedeliver`) asks, right after the auth gate and the `401` and before the request body is read, whether the signed-in caller may administer webhooks (`redeliver-entitlement.ts`):
  - the caller's `ExecutionContext` comes from `resolveRequestExecutionContext` (the one platform composition), fed the session the door already read (`session: { established }`), so the gate judges exactly the identity the door acts as;
  - the decision is `ISecurityService.explain({ object: 'sys_webhook', operation: 'update' }, context).allowed` (ADR-0124 D1: server-side);
  - refused: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, one fixed answer, so nothing in it depends on a delivery row; no security service, or a check that throws: `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (ADR-0124 D3: an undecided case is never admitted; cause logged at `error`).
- **The organization (this round's must-fix).** The composition is now handed the door's own `tenancy` resolver (`redeliverTenancyResolver`), so the session's organization claim is vetted against the posture in force exactly as the data API's doors vet it (the per-request membership check of the 2026-09-05 ruling, option B). The resolver reads the kernel's async accessor (`getServiceAsync('tenancy')`) where the kernel has one, so `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` sees the registry's own answer: never registered is no posture, registered and failing is the outage the gate's `catch` answers `503`. On a factory-less `KernelBase` host the sync accessor's only fault is "not registered", absorbed inside the thunk. The admission carries the vetted `tenantId`, and the replay is scoped to it, never to the raw session claim.
- **A claim the composition did not keep is refused** with the same `403` body. The replay is scoped by one organization; a dropped claim leaves none, and threading none would be an unscoped write, wider than any write the data API's gate gives that caller (with no active organization the tenant layer denies every row under `isolated` and admits only the caller's own organizations under `group`, a set this door's single-tenant scope cannot express). The principal is not refused: the session stays signed in with no active organization, as option B prescribes; only this door's act, which needs an organization, is declined.
- **Absence is loud at boot.** When the door is served on either face and no security service can decide, the plugin says once at `kernel:ready`, at `warn`, that every caller will be answered `503`, naming the remedy (compose `@objectstack/plugin-security`).
- **Why `update` on `sys_webhook`, not `read` on `sys_http_delivery`.** Replaying a delivery is a write-shaped act (the row resets and a signed request goes out), the same power as editing or re-activating the subscription; a read-only principal holding a read wildcard must not gain it. The axis is pending the maintainer (see 维护者速读).
- **Unchanged for an entitled caller:** the ADR-0069 gate, `401`, the `400` body refusals, active-organization scoping (`404` outside it), the redelivery veto's `409`s, the `200` replay. The door still admits no API key.
- **Docs and records.** `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` section 8 states the gate and the organization vetting; checklist `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` r12 (posture sentence) and r13 (this round: acceptance[4].verify no longer cites a no-capability docblock, steps[6] drives the redeliver as the seeded admin, the walled-posture refusal is named) and `integration-system.notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility` r4; the two stale "any authenticated user" docblocks in `service-messaging` (`http-outbox.ts` `RedeliverOptions`, `sql-http-outbox.ts` `redeliver`) now state the gate; an ADR-0124 anchor for `redeliver-entitlement.ts`; the dogfood authz matrix row; the engine-double ledger row; the changeset declares the narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the BREAKING banner, one ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), level `patch`.

## Tests

At b4a2146cb6 (local, on a shared box):

- `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` `pnpm test`: `Test Files 24 passed (24) · Tests 252 passed (252)`; `typecheck` (tsc, scripts tsconfig, test layer) exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts`: 21 cases (11 before this round). New: on `isolated`, an administrator whose claimed organization no current membership backs is refused with the byte-identical body an unentitled member gets, nothing replayed (both faces); on `group`, a claim on an organization the caller left is refused for that organization's delivery and for the one it still belongs to (both faces); control, a backed claim is admitted, the replay is threaded with that organization and another organization's delivery answers `404` (both faces); the once-at-boot line for a kernel with no security service; on a real `ObjectKernel` registry, the resolver reads never-registered as no posture, a walled posture as the drop, and a `tenancy` factory that throws as `503` with the cause logged and the security service never asked. The security double now records the organization the caller's context was resolved in.
- `@objectstack/service-messaging` (comment-only edits): `typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm test` `Test Files 62 passed (62) · Tests 739 passed (739)`.

## Acceptance notes

- The review suggested reaching the `tenancy` service "through the same `tryGetService` discipline". The resolver deliberately does not use the plugin's swallowing `tryGetService` on a kernel with `getServiceAsync`: it would read a registered-and-failed service as absent, the permissive-on-failure collapse `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` exists to prevent. The sync, swallowing leg is used only on a factory-less `KernelBase` host, the same split `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts` records.
- Threading the vetted `tenantId` rather than the raw claim has no behaviour difference on an admitted call (the gate refuses whenever they differ), so it is pinned structurally (the replay's organization is asserted in the control case) and not ablated separately.
- Kept as found, noted: `http-outbox-parked-record.integration.test.ts`'s docblock narrates the pre-#8069 state ("which any authenticated user can reach") as history, not as the current posture.
- `tryGetService(['security'])` treats a throwing lookup as absent, so a kernel that never registered `security` answers `503` with a remedy, never a silent admit.
- The gate is asked of `sys_webhook` (this plugin's configuration object), not of a host-renamed `subscriptionsObject`.
